fact: On 22 September 2026 Haweya's managing director said the digital identity platform would start its first phase with 5 banks and extend to all banks in Egypt within 18 months, with customer data compared against civil status data sources.
title: «هوية» تبدأ تشغيل الهوية الرقمية مع 5 بنوك.. وتستهدف ضم جميع البنوك في مصر خلال 18 شهرًا
